teaser: The furnace clicks on somewhere under the floor, a sound you stopped noticing years ago but would miss. You are a 4, and an INTJ, and the two of you have built the same room from opposite directions. The number lays the foundation; the letters draw the blueprint before the foundation is poured. Most people meet you already standing on something load-bearing, with the joints kept out of sight. What is particular here is how little drama the construction requires — steady hands meet a mind that already has a model for where the walls go, and the two rarely argue about whether to build, only about how long to keep checking the measurements.
